title: German Squash Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful German-inspired casserole featuring roasted squash as the main ingredient.
instructions: Toss the cubed squash with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 30 minutes.
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened. Add the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually pour in the vegetable broth and milk, whisking continuously. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened.
Stir in the grated cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the roasted squash, sautéed onion mixture, and chopped fresh parsley (if using).
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with breadcrumbs.
Bake for an additional 20-25 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Let the casserole rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
